summary: Fix correctly avoids axes.set_prop_cycle so CN color references work and the global cycler is no longer mutated, resolving the core issue. However it replaces the cycler-based iteration with a plain iter(colors), silently dropping the documented behavior that a shorter colors list repeats/cycles through the stacked layers.

issues.description: stackplot's colors docstring states the sequence need not match the number of series and will repeat from the beginning. Using iter(colors) instead of itertools.cycle(colors) means once colors is exhausted, next(color_cycle) raises an uncaught StopIteration instead of cycling, breaking documented behavior for any colors list shorter than the number of stacked layers.
next(color_cycle) if color_cycle else ... relies on iterator truthiness pattern; using itertools.cycle would be the more idiomatic and correct fix matching the original cycling semantics.
